annotation.title_clean: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order of January 23, 2025 revoking Biden's EO 14110 on safe, secure and trustworthy AI. It sets a policy of sustaining US AI dominance, orders an AI Action Plan within 180 days, and directs agencies to rescind inconsistent actions and revise OMB memoranda M-24-10 and M-24-18.
key_provisions_or_claims: Policy: sustain and enhance US global AI dominance for human flourishing, competitiveness and national security
Develop an AI Action Plan within 180 days
Review and suspend, revise or rescind actions taken under revoked EO 14110
Revise OMB Memoranda M-24-10 and M-24-18 within 60 days
AI systems should be free from ideological bias or engineered social agendas
